review.body_original:
Beware! You do not get your tickets immediately!

I purchased two tickets to go to the palace of culture and science put in all of my information then got the notification that I would receive my tickets in two hours. I never heard this before I paid for them. That will mean that I cannot go because it will interfere with another tour that I had. As most people who purchased something online, you get it within seconds or minutes. So, I reached out to customer service and they basically said they buy them from someone else and I won’t get them, but I can use them next year. I’m going back to the US in the morning. I do not recommend this at all. Kind of a scam kind of shady behavior.
